messages:
elaine-product: Quick sync — legal needs final wording for Q3 Dedicated contracts. We need decisions on: node-slicing (fractional reservations), how burst minutes are billed, SLA bands for p50/p95 tail, and a simple launch KPI set. Can we lock this by Friday?
mateo-pm: Agree. My proposed compromise: two reservation primitives — a 'base commit' (locked capacity) + 'burst pool' billed by minute. Burst pool supports fractional nodes (0.1 increments) so customers don't overcommit.
mateo-pm: Example billing idea: base commit monthly price + burst-minute rate where first 5000 burst-minutes/month are at discounted rate. After that, standard burst rate.
sanjay-eng: Technically fractional nodes is doable via node-slicing but has tradeoffs for cold-start latency on large models. Need warm pool warmup config and cap on concurrent fractional shards.
sanjay-eng: If we allow unconstrained fractional slices the KV cache misses will spike and p95 will jump. Suggest: limit fractional shards per tenant to 8 and enforce warm-pool threshold of 10s prewarm.
liam-ml: From evals, p50 is stable but p95 is sensitive to shard churn. Recommend SLA tiers: Bronze (p95 < 1.2s), Silver (p95 < 800ms), Gold (p95 < 400ms) with higher committed capacity. These are across 16k context models.
karen-cs: Sales asks to surface burst budget in console and show projected cost for burst usage. Also customers want an "emergency hold" toggle to pause burst charges during an incident.
toni-legal: For contract language, we need: exact definitions of "burst-minute", measurement window, and clear credit mechanics for SLA misses. Also want a clause for preempt eviction windows. Please draft definitions.
elaine-product: Draft language proposal: "Burst-minute: one minute of compute above customer's committed baseline measured at per-region level. Fractional reservation increments are charged per 0.1 node-minute." Thoughts?
mateo-pm: That works but add a cap: "Monthly burst discount applies to first X burst-minutes per billing unit" and call out how carryover credits (if any) behave.
sanjay-eng: Operational note: implement a soft-preempt grace period for fractional shards so we don't evict mid-request. Suggest 120s eviction_window and a 10s drain signal to the runtime.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new RFC draft posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1959876500-node-slicing. Please review before EOD Thu.
liam-ml: Launch KPIs proposal: 1) median p50/p95 for committed workloads, 2) % of requests served from cache, 3) burst-minute revenue delta vs. forecast, 4) number of tenant evictions per week. Recommend thresholds for go/no-go.
karen-cs: Customer-facing checklist: console visibility, billing examples, support playbook for burst disputes, and a clear rollback path if SLA regressions appear.
toni-legal: I'll prepare SOW language for the three SLA bands and the credit formula. Need final numeric SLOs from eng/product by Thu noon.
elaine-product: Action items: Mateo — finalize burst discount tiers and example billing table; Sanjay — propose warm-pool + eviction_window defaults and resource caps; Liam — finalize numeric SLOs and KPIs; Toni — draft SOW clauses after we lock numbers.
mateo-pm: I'll push a sample billing table to the RFC by 11:00.
sanjay-eng: I'll add a config snippet to the RFC. Paste here for visibility:
```json
{
  "reservation": "base",
  "min_instances": 2,
  "fractional_increment": 0.1,
  "warm_pool_secs": 10,
  "eviction_window_secs": 120,
  "burst_cap_per_tenant": 8
}
```
liam-ml: I'll run a small sim against the 16k model trace and post results. If p95 jumps > 20% under expected churn, we back off fractional by default.
karen-cs: FYI — two customers already asked for a "burst-only" promo for onboarding. We'll need a billing SKU for that.
elaine-product: OK — target: lock numbers Thu noon, legal to get SOW by Fri EOD. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
